title: Handshake
subtitle: progressive house · two arpeggios fall into phase
statement: Two arpeggios, one in each ear, a few sixteenths apart. Every section the gap closes, until they lock and become one voice.
intro: Two machines on the same network, trying to agree when 'now' is.

sections.name: Listen
sections.intent: Kick, hats and a rimshot; the bass rolls in at bar 9.
moves: Drums only for 8 bars, for the mix.

sections.name: SYN
sections.intent: Arp A enters on the left, filtered.
moves: Arp A alone, its filter opening.

sections.name: SYN-ACK
sections.intent: Arp B answers on the right, three 16ths late.
moves: Arp B delayed by 3/16: a canon.

sections.name: ACK
sections.intent: Kick out. Electric piano and pad under the arps; the gap closes to 2, then 1.

sections.name: Connected
sections.intent: The arps lock in phase. Lead says the handshake, full drums.
moves: Gap 0: the arps fuse into one wide sound.

sections.name: Keepalive
sections.intent: Just pad and arps, a breath before the end.

sections.name: Disconnect
sections.intent: Drums and bass; the arps close their filters; last 8 bars drums only.
moves: Drums alone for the next mix.

layers.name: Kick
layers.description: A round 909-style kick tuned near C.
layers.purpose: The clock both machines sync to.

layers.name: Clap & rim
layers.description: Clap on 2 and 4, a rimshot answering on the off-beats.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, shaker

layers.name: Hats
layers.description: Metallic hats from six band-limited square oscillators (the 808 recipe): short closed ticks and off-beat open hats, almost no noise.
layers.purpose: The tick of the groove, kept small.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, shaker

layers.name: Arp A (left)
layers.description: A pluck arpeggio on the chord tones, two octaves up, on an E(11,16) rhythm. Left of centre.
layers.math: rhythm E(11,16); B trails A by 3, 2, 1, 0 sixteenths

instrument.name: Pluck
instrument.description: Saw and square, a little detuned, with a fast filter snap and short decay.

layers.name: Arp B (right)
layers.description: The same arpeggio, trailing by a few 16ths, on the right. At the drop the gap is zero and the two fuse.

instrument.name: Pluck
instrument.description: Saw and square, a little detuned, with a fast filter snap and short decay.

layers.name: Rolling bass
layers.description: Off-beat rolling bass on each chord's root: saw and sub into a ladder filter. Since take 3 it rides above the warm bass, high-passed at 220 Hz: the bite and the talk, not the weight.

instrument.name: Mono Synth
instrument.description: Saw, square and sub oscillators, glide, vibrato and an enveloped resonant filter.

layers.name: Pad
layers.description: Wide slow supersaw chords, pumped hard by the kick.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Electric piano
layers.description: FM electric piano comping in the break.
layers.purpose: A human hand in the middle.

instrument.name: FM Electric Piano
instrument.description: Two-operator FM: a warm 1:1 body and a ratio-14 tine strike, with stereo tremolo.

layers.name: Lead
layers.description: Supersaw lead: C, G, C, E-flat (the handshake), then an answer that walks back down.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Synth choir
layers.description: A synth choir: four drifting, vibrato-ed saw singers per note through five choir formants, each chord walking its own vowels. No breath noise.
layers.purpose: Fills the top with voices instead of hiss.

instrument.name: Synth Choir
instrument.description: An ensemble of drifting, vibrato-ed saws per note through five choir formants; tones, no noise.

layers.name: Pulse bass
layers.description: Juno / SH-101 style: a slowly breathing pulse and a square sub through a 24 dB low-pass.
layers.purpose: The warm foundation: it owns everything below about 250 Hz.

instrument.name: Pulse Bass (Juno-style)
instrument.description: A slowly breathing pulse and a square sub through a 24 dB low-pass with a short snap.

instrument.name: Transition FX
instrument.description: Noise risers, downlifters, impacts, crashes, reversed crashes and sub drops.

layers.name: Voice A (left)
layers.description: The one who sends the first signal: close, human, a little to the left like arp A.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Voice B (right, vocoder)
layers.description: The answer, through the vocoder, a little to the right like arp B: out of time at first.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Both voices (chorus)
layers.description: Connected: the human voice with doubles and the vocoder voice together.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Robots
layers.description: A modem playing the album's handshake, packet bursts, a droid, a mainframe thinking, a chord materialising into the drop, and the line powering down.

instrument.name: Robot rack
instrument.description: Machines from the batsynth robot library (servos, droids, modems, coils, turbines, alarms, clocks).

lanes.name: arp gap (16ths)
lanes.description: How far arp B trails arp A.

lanes.name: tension (plan)
lanes.description: How tense each section is meant to feel.

motifs.how: the opening of every 8-bar lead phrase

lyrics.text: I sent a look across the floor,
a little signal in the dark,
I sent it twice, a little longer,
I caught it late, a beat behind,
you answer back and we're in time,
hold the line, hold the line,
you answer back and we're in time,
hold the line, hold the line,

lyrics_take4.text: I send a signal into the dark: are you there?
I send it again, a little louder: are you there?
Something answers, out of time with me: I'm here. Are you?
Three steps apart, then two, then one.
Syn, ack, I hear you hear me,
three small words and we're connected,
hold the line, hold the line,
Syn, ack, I hear you hear me,
three small words and we're connected,
hold the line, hold the line,
